usage: policy for any type of static security Scan by Severity
name: Container secrets issues should not occur
description: Containers are typically executable parts of your application running on-prem or in the cloud. Therefore, container secrets issues can introduce security vulnerabilities with severe business impacts.
detailedDescription: Containers are a significant component of executing SAAS applications. Container base images, potential security secrets, and container security at runtime related to users, networks, file systems, etc., can all lead to security vulnerabilities. Identifying these is extremely important.

args.name: ignoreBusinessPriority
args.label: Ignore Application Business Priority for severity calculation
args.tooltip: If enabled the severity of an issue will not be affected by the Application Business Priority
